verdict.rationale: Firstbase's compliance dashboard shows company status per state with upcoming deadlines and required actions (docs-7, docs-28), and bookkeepers/tax reminders are mentioned (docs-9, docs-10), suggesting deadline visibility. However, there's no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'compliance calendar' view or proactive reminder/notification system before each deadline. Missing for 10: explicit reminder/notification mechanism (email/push alerts before deadlines), a calendar-style UI, and independent/hands-on confirmation that deadlines are surfaced proactively rather than just viewable on request.
